# Multi-Mini-Games Suite

Welcome to the **Multi-Mini-Games Suite**! This repository is a collection of three classic, interactive text-based terminal games built to pass the time and test your skills. Whether you want to challenge your intuition, rely on pure strategy, or test your trivia knowledge, this suite has something for you.

##  Included Games

* **Number Guessing Game:** Guess the secret number generated by the computer within a limited number of attempts. The system provides "too high" or "too low" hints along the way.
* **Rock, Paper, Scissors:** The classic hand game against an AI opponent. Play individual matches or keep track of your running score.
* **General Knowledge Quiz:** Test your brain across various topics! Answer multiple-choice trivia questions and see your final score at the end.

## Features

* Interactive and user-friendly command-line interface (CLI)
* Input validation to prevent crashes from accidental typos
* Replayability options so you can play again without restarting the script
* Live score tracking for competitive sessions
